scope: Post-result descriptive probability diagnostics on already opened development folds; no fitting, retuning or held-back labels.
bin_boundaries: [0,0.1], (0.1,0.2], ..., (0.9,1]; empty bins remain NaN and counts are saved
calibrators: Reuse frozen calibration-window estimators; never fit to validation labels
metrics: Native binary Brier mean squared error before/after calibration; ten-bin ECE is descriptive only
